proposals.entity_key: Infinitive after expressions of spending time

evidence.notes: Source gives passer son temps, passer ses vacances, gaspiller sa vie, perdre son temps with à + infinitive; examples instantiate expression + à + infinitive. Low uncertainty.

Source keeps subject + verb order with rising intonation (Tu finis à cinq heures?) and gives the negative pattern subject + ne + verb + pas?; both forms retain statement order. Intonation itself is not representable in writing.
Source describes verb-subject inversion with hyphen and -t- insertion when the third-person singular verb ends in a vowel; the pairs show the plain inversion and the -t- case. Low uncertainty.
Source lists rising intonation (Tu te couches déjà?), est-ce que, and inversion, noting the reflexive pronoun stays before the verb in inversion (Te couches-tu?). Low uncertainty.
Source lists interrogative words que, comment, pourquoi, quoi followed by the infinitive; examples instantiate question word + infinitive. Low uncertainty.
